title: How To Change The Name, Tab Title & URL Of A Post Type
text:
## How To Change The Name, Tab Title & URL Of A Post Type
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000028489
To change the title of a post type, please do the following:
Go to Content >> Edit Post Settings
Find the post type that needs to be renamed and click on Edit , for this, we are going to use the Classified Post Type as an example.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005646/original/BtmxC9KeCCZQDPUWmxffSXM85k6NZDqGXA.png?1789066758 | alt: ]

## Post Type Name
In the General Settings Tab (Add an unique name for the post):
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005696/original/h9-ObQ7TrdloFS7wp4ktYT0Sxhnv7lpq_Q.png?1789066799 | alt: ]

## URL Permalink
Update the URL to match the name:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005708/original/kmqKmf7A3QnWUUObsEcu8AtSh5grTDi8xQ.png?1789066828 | alt: ]

## Profile Page Tab Title
Profile Page Design Tab (This is the title that is going to show up on the Member's Profile):
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005746/original/YLO-t-0-AC9gqNfiNXwTK6G-inZU8Nq7LQ.png?1789066878 | alt: ]

## Search Results Page Title
Search Results Design (This title is going to appear when accessing the actual search results visible to the visitors and other members)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005777/original/mqVV2cW6l-8nFVDrVqQyA-DfFr-nZbPNlA.png?1789066930 | alt: ]
Lastly, click on Save Changes.

## Confirm Changes
When Saving the Post Type, a message will display to confirm this change: "The URL of this Post Type is being changed from classifieds to brilliant-classifieds. This action will also update the slug URL of all associated posts."
This means that already created posts showing under the URL  /classifieds now are going to display under /brilliant-classiffieds.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005872/original/fAwVobIMr1kMafVjXNrJY__jwzzzXD6c6w.png?1789066993 | alt: ]
Make sure to always refresh the cache of the website to see the changes: Refreshing Live Site

## Changed Title and URL
The new Title and URL will be automatically updated and display on the front end.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185005927/original/mQ-qSH3qNzNC54ccr9GVLJZuX513FQ9N1w.png?1789067090 | alt: ]
